requirements.evidence: Contract matches task: CallMode enum (app/Enums/CallMode.php:5-10), NoWaitingTicketsException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7), invokable action with the required signature (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:26). Queue re-read under lockForUpdate and is_active checked from the locked row (:30-38); ordering priority DESC, issued_at, id (:91-94); modes via match (:83-89); fairness re-evaluated on each loop iteration with the 3-call history ordered by called_at DESC, id DESC (:102-118); candidate row lock + status re-check with skip loop (:41-60); only status/called_at/called_by_user_id set and the updated model returned (:62-67). Small gap: the history query filters `status = Called` (:104) rather than 'tickets that were called' (called_at not null), so if called tickets later move to another status they would drop out of the fairness window.

conventions.evidence: Domain write in app/Actions as an invokable single-use-case class; no service layer; PHPDoc on the public method (:20-25); docs/business-rules.md and docs/architecture.md updated (removing the stale TODO and linking the test), CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased]. No authorization inside the action, as the task explicitly requires.

security.evidence: No HTTP/Livewire surface; the caller is trusted by the task. Queue state is read from the DB under lock, not from the passed model (:30-34); ticket row is locked and re-checked for exactly-once (:50-59); no mass assignment, explicit property sets.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php covers ordering and id tie-break (:322-332), returned/persisted state (:334-349), other queues/already called (:351-364), empty queue, inactive and stale queue (:366-390), both restricted modes (:392-416), fairness streak, no-normal case, <3 history, priority_only calls counted, reset, history tie-break by id, per-queue history (:418-512) and a simulated concurrent call via a retrieved hook (:514-537). Gaps: 'ignores fairness in priority_only and normal_only modes' only exercises priority_only (:479-488); no test that the action does not touch other columns (write-once); global helpers `waiting`/`calledTicket` may collide with other Pest files.

simplicity.evidence: ~120-line action with one query builder helper and one fairness helper; constant FAIRNESS_STREAK; no extra abstractions; reuses existing InactiveQueueException and TicketStatus enum.

readability.evidence: Clear names (candidates, mustServeNormal, lockedQueue) and focused comments (:29, :49). Using `match` purely for side effects with a `null` arm (:83-89) is slightly unusual; `while (true)` with continue/return is readable but could be a bounded loop.

scope.evidence: Only the action, enum, exception, test, the two docs the task names and a CHANGELOG line; no HTTP/Livewire or authorization added.

issues.explanation: The fairness history only counts tickets currently in status `called`; tickets that were called and later moved to another status (e.g. served/finished) would be ignored, so `whereNotNull('called_at')` would match 'last 3 tickets called' more robustly.
The test named for ignoring fairness in priority_only and normal_only modes only asserts the priority_only case.
Global helper functions `waiting()` and `calledTicket()` in a Pest file share the global namespace and can clash with helpers in other test files.
`match` used for side effects with a `null` arm is less clear than a plain if/when on the query.

review.summary: Adds CallNextTicket with CallMode and NoWaitingTicketsException, implementing deterministic ordering, the three modes, the 3-call fairness rule, queue-row locking with a fresh is_active check and a candidate-row lock with skip-on-race, plus thorough Pest tests and the required doc updates. Only small gaps remain (history filtered by current `called` status, one mode not covered by its fairness test), so I would approve with nits.
